mechanism: Fenofibrate may increase the risk of myositis/rhabdomyolysis, particularly in patients with renal impairment; chlorthalidone can cause electrolyte abnormalities and worsen renal function, increasing fenofibrate nephrotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and creatine kinase periodically; adjust fenofibrate dose based on renal function; maintain adequate hydration and consider alternative antilipidemic agents if renal function declines.
